perspectives.title: Remove Schumer
perspectives.summary: Schumer and Jeffries should be replaced

representative_posts.author: deletex.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer and Jeffries must go. Enough of this good old boy network in the pocket of corporate and foreign interests. Enough.

representative_posts.author: sp4zsquatch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer is too compromised because of who his donors are. Jeffries too.

representative_posts.author: pjdillon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Democrats need to get their shit together. We don't want Schumer or Jeffries. Don't fuck this up. You Represent us and we collectively don't want either of them because of their absolute shit decisions they've made which is prelude to the shit decisions their going to make. Don't sell us out

representative_posts.author: coronasun62.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yes please!!! I am angry that Schumer and Jeffries are being considered to be the leaders and already talking compromise with Trump! Like WTF?!

representative_posts.author: bigrickbz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nothing happens if Jeffries and Schumer are leaders. Both must go!

representative_posts.author: jennybigcat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I love the change in direction. And I say let’s go for Jeffries and Schumer next. We need leadership that can meet the moment and they’ve already proven they can’t.

representative_posts.author: projectspacetime.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hear this guy out. He’s making it clear about what’s going to happen due to how Schumer and Jeffries have told all of us to shut the fuck up.

representative_posts.author: ronault.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If the Democrats make Schumer & Jeffries the top guys, it will be the same old bullshit! They will screw up what many worked so hard for!

representative_posts.author: betsy-cazden.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone who's coming in from outside and imagines that Schumer played no role in the Democratic victories needs to take a seat and wait until they learn how things really work in the Senate. Same for Jeffries and the House.

representative_posts.author: superchivas.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: They better. And DO NOT put #Schumer or #Jeffries in charge of anything.

representative_posts.author: newsbynature.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is why we need new leadership. Does anyone really think Schumer and Jeffries are going to take the dirty money out of our electoral process when they depend on it so heavily.

representative_posts.author: titubasrevenge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I agree. No to Jeffries. No to Schumer. We voted you new Dems in for change. We expect to see big changes starting with Democrat leadership.

representative_posts.author: pk-solo-1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We can thank Schumer & Jeffries for their previous leadership gracefully and ask them to stand aside. They deserve respect for years of service. However, these are unprecedented times we’ve lived through & the newer, younger, female led future is here. They are energized to take this corruption on.!

representative_posts.author: bchristyb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 💯 Schumer needs to usher in a new generation of Dem leadership. The time is now! Jeffries befriended Kushner & welcomed war criminal Netanyahu to the House. And his comments after Tuesday’s political earthquake were so milquetoast, feckless & tone deaf. We need courageous, fierce leaders now!

representative_posts.author: riem.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Every Democrat I have seen on SM and elsewhere, wants Schumer and Jeffries gone, effective immediately. Certainly have only seen Schumer described as the architect of the Blue Wave here:

representative_posts.author: shellnoel34.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I want new Leaders! Schumer pressured Biden to step down yet he can't do the same?Schumer is like a Repub to me. All about power& greed. Jefferies don't trust.What he did in Valerie Foushee race here in NC was shady.I feel he won't work for us. He will put big donors 1st. Schumer of course does.

representative_posts.author: iimh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No Schumer, no Jeffries. How about Warren and AOC. New day, new congressional leadership.

representative_posts.author: robotimpurity.com
representative_posts.text: I've already contact all three of my reps to let them know Schumer and Jeffries aren't meant this moment in history. I encourage every US voter to do the same.

representative_posts.author: thatjoeguy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m already sick to death of the “we must replace Schumer and Jeffries” without a single name put forward as to whom they would prefer. It’s just crying and laziness, the typical formula of certain factions of Democrat hangers-on.

representative_posts.author: lordboise.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So far, absolutely no one wants that wretched job other than Schumer. He has maybe 6 Senators wanting to replace him. It'll take 2 things - 1. An opponent to run against him and 2. 28 votes for that opponent.

representative_posts.author: alegriaboulangere.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: SCHUMER JUST DISQUALIFIED HIMSELF TO BECOMING MAJORITY LEADER BY GOING ON AIR AND PLEADING WITH US TO VOTE FOR HIM. THAT'S PATHETIC. MAYBE IT WAS MY CALL WHERE I TOLD HIM TO ACT LIKE A BIG BOY AND STEP ASIDE. IF HE CARES AS MUCH AS HE SAYS HE DOES, HE WILL STEP ASIDE. P.S. ONLY SENATORS VOTE!

representative_posts.author: nejackson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No one has put Schumer and Jefferies in charge of the next Congess. Have patience.

representative_posts.author: saltybiscuit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m just hoping this galvanizes Schumer, Jeffries, and old guard. Who all, by the way, need to be driven out of leadership in January and shown the door in their next election cycle. Not that I have much hope of that happening.

representative_posts.author: researchette.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And for some reason he feels strongly about Schumer and Jeffries staying in leadership.

representative_posts.author: surelyyoujokeme.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Get Schumer out. Please. We need younger people and fresh directions in that position.

representative_posts.author: raybeckerman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The problem with Schumer and Jeffries is that they think they know better than their constituents. They don't understand that they work for us, we don't work for them.

representative_posts.author: fascismheckler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So everyone saying "WE NEED TO OVERTHROW SCHUMER AND JEFFRIES", find a new hobby. Schumer said he already has the voters to be Majority Leader. And NOTHING is stopping Jeffries from becoming Speaker. Trying to argue against it proves how little you respect Black people

representative_posts.author: pompera-firpa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: NO MORE CORPORATE DEMOCRATS IN CHARGE. KICK OUT SCHUMER.

representative_posts.author: winnbear.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We ALL SUPPORT IT! Schumer has to go!

representative_posts.author: tmbhmltn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sometimes I think “on the plus side if we replaced Schumer/Jeffries these guys would shut up finally” but very quickly I’m reminded that they absolutely would not

representative_posts.author: tastewart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We never found out what that was about did we? Yeah, he and Schumer need to go on and let others be speaker of the house and leader of the senate.

representative_posts.author: cosmonomadxazos.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Uhh... Saying Schumer and Jeffries "orchestrated" this win absolutely ignores that they also *refused* to support or endorse MANY Democratic candidates in the midterms. Candidates who just happened to be 1) Black and/or 2) openly opposed to g3nos!d3. Seeking new leadership seems 100% appropriate.

representative_posts.author: alkramer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If Schumer had had his way, Mike Rogers would have defeated the moderates ( and AIPAC’s) preferred candidate, Haley Stevens! First order of business is to clear him out of the leadership!

representative_posts.author: carolyn0909.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Listen to what Hillary has to say about replacing Chuck Schumer.

representative_posts.author: mayhem1994.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Reminder: Unfortunately for Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries more than a few of the candidates that WON on Tuesday did so IN SPITE of Schumer and Jeffries’s opposition to their candidacy in the primaries. Like my mayor. They have already signaled a lack of intention to give them a Vote

representative_posts.author: joshuahind.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Giving Schumer credit for a landside which saw a host of candidates the Democratic establishment either neglected or actively worked against coming to Congress is...the fuckin' Atlantic for ya.

representative_posts.author: ecutruin.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: While I think that there is a legitimate argument to be made to ban low effort AI-assisted content, a complete ban on AI content would hurt a storefront. representative_posts.author: radiochio.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean, is there really a market for AI slop games? representative_posts.author: weissstreifen.eu
representative_posts.text: In a perfect world you are right. But in a world where you import like 425 libraries to build a game there is 0 chance you don't use AI generated code. representative_posts.author: kotsu.red
representative_posts.text: The only genuine actual use cases I can see for AI: - Quick answers - Better voice-to-text - Automatic alt texts on social media - Perhaps some occasional game mechanic (infinite craft comes to mind) Generating code is arguable if you actually know what you’re doing.

Sports.name: Bogle Incident

perspectives.title: Bogle Incident

representative_posts.author: hannahryan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tel obviously can’t continue and Bogle didn’t even get a yellow. Ridiculous

representative_posts.author: gillesy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “He can’t give a yellow there if he didn’t give one to Bogle.” Right, so because he missed Bogle’s foul, the ref now has to get every other decision wrong as well?

representative_posts.author: tobysaunders94.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How was that not a red card for Bogle

representative_posts.author: zacconnolly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean, it sucks that Tel gets caught, and it's a foul and should have been a yellow, but you feel like they were REALLY trying to find a red card for Bogle, there. #lufc

representative_posts.author: paulvcooke.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The ref has made a right hash of that. Red card all day long. very poor challenge from Bogle and did not even book him. Shocking.

representative_posts.author: northerneater.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Zero intent from Bogle there, didn't lunge in. Never a red, despite the TNT commentary team begging for it. Clumsy tackle though and should've been a yellow. #lufc

representative_posts.author: fplmaison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Think Bogle has got away with one there. Looked like a red card. Didn’t even get a yellow. What is VAR for again?! #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: mrpmharrison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Interesting following this game on text (couldn't find a stream). The Guardian liveblog thought the #lufc penalty was nailed on. They also thought Bogle should have walked. Sounds like the ref's having a mare.

representative_posts.author: mattgoldspink.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Thing is Tel holds his leg there…. There’s defo contact but Bogle wouldn’t anticipate Tels leg was there… bogles eyes are on the ball and was just planting his foot expecting tel to have moved…

representative_posts.author: roblewis78.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Not even a yellow for Bogle after VAR stops the game for 5 minutes to watch multiple slow motion replays of a challenge that was probably deserving of a red. 🤔 #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: grahamdjohns.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bogle makes what is effectively an assault on Tel's ankle, & the ref somehow doesn't see it as punishable. VAR then somehow decides it's not a straight red offence, despite it looking worse with every replay. No card for Bogle. Stockley Park's main concern is protecting the official.

representative_posts.author: rototrix.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's not a red. Bogle does not go in overly aggressively - no stamp, no sliding, no excessive force. He places his trailing left standing foot on Tel's achilles - it is unfortunate & of course, it looks bad in slow motion. But that doesn't make it a red card offense. #lufc #thfc #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: thatboyparker.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No doubting it's hurt him. But Bogle's eyes are watching the ball not the player and he's trying to turn to follow the ball. It's so accidental I don't see any argument for it being a red. Yellow for the trip definitely. But never a red IMO

representative_posts.author: dontcurbyourcoys.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No yellow or red for Bogle. Tel has to stay off the field for 30 seconds and Leeds nearly score. Then Tel is too injured to continue. Ridiculous few minutes for Tottenham and Tel

representative_posts.author: macca-93.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I dunno, Bogle may be a lucky boy....though we are owed it after the handball that wasn't given

representative_posts.author: doctoralexh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bogle is on the tightest of tightropes as well now. Once ref sees it at half time, clear yellow if nothing else.

representative_posts.author: knutcrosswords.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bogle was lucky... the lack of intent saved him but I suspect Tel might be out for a while

representative_posts.author: spuddy10.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean if you have to watch 20-30 replays that kinda tells me it’s not clear & obvious error. Just get on with game………flip side how Bogle wasn’t booked god only knows.

representative_posts.author: solidpython.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How on earth has Bogle not seen red for that!?

representative_posts.author: j0nesy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I tell you what, if that Bogle challenge was by a Spurs player, I’d be fuming if he wasn’t sent off… #LUFC

representative_posts.author: philcosta.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Think that's accidental from Bogle but it's a nasty one either way - the contact is bad. Would be funny if they sent him off after what happened with Nyoni and Odegaard last week.

representative_posts.author: northerneater.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Granted I'm biased but I'd call that clear and obvious. Bogle's was one that can be a red (against the "big 6") but probably shouldn't be.

representative_posts.author: gillesy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For almost the entire history of football, you’d say “Bogle’s got away with one there” but no we get commentators trying to drum up controversy.

representative_posts.author: countryjim.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I had exactly the same thought. He clearly didn't book Bogle because he didn't see the challenge, and wasn't told to go to the screen by the VAR. As far as he knows, it was just a coming together.

representative_posts.author: chethistory.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So Bogle goes unpunished and we lose the player. Apology from PGMOL coming next week

arguments: Bogle's challenge was a red card offense
Bogle's tackle was clumsy and deserved a yellow
Bogle got away with a bad challenge

perspectives.title: Universal Healthcare

representative_posts.author: jthrankson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It’s time! Universal Healthcare is achievable! Only HC insurance companies, some HMOs, doctors, & GOP politicians who get YUGE donations from big pharma & insurance companies whine that we can’t afford it BUT somehow we can afford billion dollar ballrooms, useless wars, $billion & a half campaigns

representative_posts.text: House Dem Caucus Chair Pete Aguilar on MfA: “People want healthcare, but they don’t necessarily think gov't implementing it is a solution either...They’re asking for help. They’re getting crushed with these costs, but they don’t really trust us to implement this well.”

representative_posts.author: anniebkay.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That’s just - uninformed. OMG look to Republicans. If Dems were in we‘d have it. I live in the great state of MA where we in effect had it, this admin has chipped away at it. Dems equal healthcare.

representative_posts.text: No one expects "free healthcare." We are already "paying out the nose" for nothing. We expect to be reasonably taxed and have healthcare.

representative_posts.author: drjqjarvis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Enough already. The time is now for better simpler healthcare financed fairly for all. Let’s put it on the ballot and vote it in for ourselves. Learn more at —volunteer, tell your story, DONATE to start this grass roots campaign!

representative_posts.text: Healthcare Insurance costs needs to be addressed. It is totally unsustainable. Short term make it affordable. Long term Medicare for all.

representative_posts.author: hikercat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Remembering the republicans first 2 weeks controlling all 3 branches of government Feb 2025. Why universal health care helps the economy. Small business employers spend less on insurance and more on salaries and hiring.

representative_posts.text: For those wondering why, some horses have an extreme sensitivity to fly bites, and these avoid bleeding, swollen legs, and horses galloping around madly. Also, some horses, mentioning no Blues, like to sleep with their legs in poo when you've spent hours bathing them for a show the next day.

perspectives.brief: Horses have distinct behaviors.
perspectives.detail:
Horse Behavior argues that Horses have distinct behaviors.

The posts defend it in their own words. @bishoujomom.bsky.social writes, “think you’ve got what it takes to tame this wild horse? 😏” @lowqualityfacts.bsky.social writes, “Me: What do we do when we fall off the horse? Kristi Noem: We kill the horse.” @extrudedsquared.bsky.social writes, “I gotta kill time for like 9 hours before I get home, ask me anything. Also here some unfinished horses I had on my phone as engagement bait”

Inside Horse Behavior, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.
